title: A to-do list
teaches: lists, the empty state, and how big a thing to tap must be
one_line: A short list of what to get done today, for one person, kept on the phone.
people: Someone with a handful of things to do today and no patience for setup
top_tasks: See what is left to do today
Add a task in a few seconds

measured: 5 things to tap: four check areas at 44 by 44 points and the button at 348 by 48. All meet the 44-point guidance.
Smallest text: 13 points (the notes under each task). The floor is 11.
Faintest text: the secondary text, 5.88:1 against the cream ground. It needs 4.5:1.
Every color is a variable. Nothing sits under the status bar or the home indicator.
So this screen came back clean. Ask for the smaller check circles and watch the check catch it.
